annotations.text: THE FIRST MINUTE — splash settles in like a plate on a table; Sign in with Apple is the only door; contacts builds your invite-only Table ("set a place" = invite).

THE DAILY APP — final register: quiet chrome, earned color. Chrome is calm and near-monochrome so every family's photos look good; color appears when something good happens — the plate reaction fills tomato, the 10th plate earns the Chef's kiss, the + button is the one always-tomato element. The fun lives in motion and voice: icons bounce, the + spins, Pick-for-me fills a day and the ring ticks up.
Owner = crowned "Head of table." Assign days per person, auto-rotate open days, kids contribute ideas. Same grammar as the week screen.
